faq.q: Do you update the profile for me or give me the copy?
faq.a: I give you ready-to-paste copy for each section plus clear instructions, so you stay in full control of your account. I don't need your login.

faq.q: Can this be bundled with a resume review?
faq.a: Yes — many people do both. Book both services and I'll keep your resume and LinkedIn positioning consistent.

faq.q: Will I show up in more recruiter searches?
faq.a: The rewrite targets the keywords and skills recruiters filter on for your roles, which is the main lever for search visibility. I can't guarantee specific inbound, but I optimise everything you control.

faq.q: I'm switching into product — can you help reposition me?
faq.a: That's one of the most common reasons people book this. We reframe your prior experience so it reads as relevant product evidence.
